notes: Each config changes ONE thing against base. env = environment variables of the engine (verified in the source of main@d8e49bc); the other keys are applied in game by gds_bench.lua (Lighting.set, Lighting.setVirtual, Graphics.setGroup...). 'bound' configs are upper bounds (they remove a feature to see how much it costs), not fixes.

H1.title: Texture mips: the 8K mips are uploaded with CPU copies when you get close (Megascans close-up drops)
H1.rule: confirmed when tex-low cuts the approach hitches by >= 50 %, or >= 50 % of the approach hitch frames have texture uploads (and <= 20 % of the other frames). Also: makeSrgbCopy reads an uncompressed colour texture back from the GPU on its first draw and after every restream to another size (glmodern.cpp ~2938); base counter 'modern: srgb copies (readback)' > 0 during the approach and srgb-readback (forcing it) adding >= 25 % hitches means that stall is part of the close-up drop

H2.title: Virtual geometry pages: a 64 MB pool and a per-frame load budget make the close-up stall on page loads
H2.rule: confirmed when vgeo-resident or vgeo-pool-512 cuts the approach/fly hitches by >= 50 %, or >= 50 % of the hitch frames load pages

H3.title: The Nanite-like path costs more than the classic one on these assets
H3.rule: confirmed when vgeo-off lowers the p50 frame by >= 15 % (the virtual path is slower here); refuted when it raises it by >= 15 %

H4.title: Shadows dominate the frame (full-detail casters, cascades redrawn, wind in the shadow casters)
H4.rule: confirmed when shadows-off lowers p50 by >= 25 % or the shadow passes are >= 30 % of the GPU frame in base

H5.title: LOD is not aggressive enough (trees and props drawn at full detail far away, in the shadows too)
H5.rule: confirmed when lod-coarsest lowers p50 by >= 25 % (the room a better LOD policy can win)

H6.title: Masked foliage overdraw (leaves, grass): many layers of cut-out pixels
H6.rule: confirmed when foliage-low lowers p50 by >= 20 % and resolution-50 also does (pixel bound)

H7.title: Global illumination / Lumen costs too much with vegetation
H7.rule: confirmed when gi-off lowers p50 by >= 15 %

H8.title: Instancing / GPU-driven: wrong materials (A1) and what each path costs
H8.rule: A1 isolation: the picture of gpu-driven-off differs from base -> the GPU-driven path; only instancing-off differs -> the instance classes / instanced shaders. Cost: vgeo-unified >= 10 % faster makes its material bug worth fixing. Note: NC_INSTANCING=0 also turns off GPU-driven, retained scene, GPU LOD, pre-skin, foliage, ISM sets and mesh particles, so it is not a pure instancing A/B.

H9.title: GPU pixel bound or CPU / geometry bound?
H9.rule: pixel bound when resolution-50 lowers p50 by >= 30 %; CPU / geometry bound when < 10 % (then look at cpuFrameMs and the CPU zones). fsr-quality / fsr-performance: what the upscaler (FSR 3, motion vectors fixed on 2026-10-24) buys on this scene: the default to ship when the frame is pixel bound

H10.title: The material system (shading models, sets, World Position Offset, layers, deferred table) costs more than it should
H10.rule: confirmed when models-off lowers p50 by >= 10 % on a scene whose materials are mostly Default Lit / foliage (the system promises zero cost for them), or sets-off is FASTER (the batched material paths lose). The pictures also show which feature changes the look.
